reuse.why: Puts the skip logic in getNextDate via a firstWeekdayOccurrence helper and keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but getUpcomingDates and schedule-template re-decide the daily-vs-move rule instead of delegating to one shared adjustment.

duplication.why: The condition 'skipWeekend and frequency is daily' and the resulting skip-or-move dispatch are written separately in getNextDate, schedule-template.ts and getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The core skip is in shared/schedules.ts where weekend logic lives, but the frequency-based policy also leaks into server/schedules/app.ts and the budget template code.

scope.why: Only the weekend-handling call sites, the recur data, a test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Readable, but a later change to weekend rules has to be repeated in three dispatch sites, and the schedule-template site works by inverting the noSkipWeekend flag of getNextDate, which is subtle.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates filters d.isWeekend itself for daily schedules instead of reusing getNextDate/firstWeekdayOccurrence; schedule-template.ts computes isDaily and steers getNextDate through noSkipWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip / other-move dispatch is reshaped as an early return in getNextDate, a movedForWeekend/nextOccurrence pair in schedule-template.ts and an if/else inside a loop in getUpcomingDates.

one_place.where: The rule is decided in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate (isDaily data flag), server/budget/schedule-template.ts (isDaily from frequency) and server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates (skipsWeekendDays).
